prompt: Single continuous shot. Chicken thighs patted dry, laid skin-down into a cold pan that ticks alight — the sizzle building slowly from silence to a roar as fat renders and edges crisp. Money shot: one thigh lifted to reveal deep golden shattering skin, then flipped, butter melting and foaming around it, spooned over in macro. Final beat: sliced on a board, crust crackling audibly, steam backlit. Warm 3200K side light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the building sizzle, then the crackle of the crust. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Frango de frigideira com casca crocante — sem forno, sem fritura funda.
🧾 4 sobrecoxas desossadas · sal · alho · limão · 1 colher de manteiga
1. Tempere e seque BEM o frango com papel toalha. 2. Pele pra baixo na frigideira FRIA, aí liga o fogo médio — 12 min sem mexer. 3. Vira, 4 min, manteiga no fim.
💡 Começar com a frigideira fria derrete a gordura devagar — é isso que faz a pele virar casca. Salva pra fazer quarta 📌
